FUGA Southside Ride (Bicicleteada del Sur)

Tucson, AZ · South Tucson · Social

BIPOCFamilyBeginner friendlyNo-drop

FUGA Southside Ride (Bicicleteada del Sur) is a social group ride in Tucson, AZ. It rolls last Friday of the month at 6:00 pm from El Pueblo Center. Pace: casual. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: casual. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @fugatucson the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the FUGA Southside Ride (Bicicleteada del Sur) group ride

A monthly community ride on Tucson's south side, organized by a Latino-led group that works on street safety and access. Families and all ages ride together at an easy pace. FUGA also runs a second-Sunday westside ride from November to April.
